feeds.description: My name is Diana. This blog is a means of curating and sharing my love for visual treasures - especially in the creative fields of fashion, art, design and photography (and lots of vintages, too).

feeds.title: Lillian Gray Blog
feeds.description: Lillian Gray is a multi-passionate artist-entrepreneur. The blog serves a dual purpose. One, to assist artists with the development of their creativity, provide art business tips and provide them with inspirational art history lessons. Secondly, the blog covers major activities and accomplishments of the art school, such as coverage in the media, awards received, and exhibitions.
